mapper.select: SELECT item.* FROM tb_ai_log_ai_task_item item WHERE item.ai_task_id = #{taskId} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tb_ai_log_ai_task_item newer WHERE newer.ai_task_id = item.ai_task_id AND newer.issue_group_id = item.issue_group_id AND newer.id > item.id) ORDER BY item.issue_group_id ASC FOR UPDATE
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(selection_order), 0) FROM tb_ai_log_ai_task_item WHERE ai_task_id = #{taskId}

SELECT item.id FROM tb_ai_log_ai_task_item item JOIN tb_ai_log_ai_task task ON task.id = item.ai_task_id WHERE item.ai_task_id = #{taskId} AND item.id > #{afterItemId} AND task.status IN ('WAITING','RUNNING') AND item.status = 'WAITING' AND item.rerun_status IS NULL AND item.attempt_count < item.max_attempts AND (item.lease_until IS NULL OR item.lease_until < #{now}) AND (item.next_retry_time IS NULL OR item.next_retry_time <= #{now}) ORDER BY item.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_ai_log_ai_task_item SET status = 'RUNNING', claim_token = #{claimToken}, lease_owner = #{leaseOwner}, lease_until = #{leaseUntil}, blame_author_name = NULL, blame_author_time = NULL, started_time = COALESCE(started_time, #{now}), update_time = #{now} WHERE id = #{itemId} AND status = 'WAITING' AND rerun_status IS NULL AND attempt_count < max_attempts AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until < #{now}) AND (next_retry_time IS NULL OR next_retry_time <= #{now})
mapper.sql: final_attempt_no = attempt_count, judgement = #{result.judgement}, severity = #{result.severity}, ai_category = #{result.category}, result_title = #{result.title}, result_summary = #{result.summary}, analysis_basis = #{result.analysisBasis}, root_cause = #{result.rootCause}, impact_description = #{result.impact}, recommendation = #{result.recommendation}, suggested_resolution_days = #{result.suggestedResolutionDays}, verification = #{result.verification}, uncertainty = #{result.uncertainty}, rule_suggestion = #{result.ruleSuggestion}, confidence = #{result.confidence}, human_review_required = #{result.humanReviewRequired}, result_hash = #{resultHash}, input_token_count = input_token_count + COALESCE(#{result.inputTokens}, 0), output_token_count = output_token_count + COALESCE(#{result.outputTokens}, 0), total_token_count = total_token_count + COALESCE(#{result.totalTokens}, 0), total_latency_millis = total_latency_millis + #{latencyMillis}, claim_token = NULL, lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, next_retry_time = NULL, last_error_code = NULL, last_error_message = NULL, finish_time = #{now}, update_time = #{now}
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_ai_log_ai_task_item SET status = CASE WHEN #{failure.retryable} AND attempt_count < max_attempts THEN 'WAITING' ELSE 'FAILED' END, final_attempt_no = CASE WHEN #{failure.retryable} AND attempt_count < max_attempts THEN NULL ELSE attempt_count END, next_retry_time = CASE WHEN #{failure.retryable} AND attempt_count < max_attempts THEN #{nextRetryTime} ELSE NULL END, input_token_count = input_token_count + COALESCE(#{failure.inputTokens}, 0), output_token_count = output_token_count + COALESCE(#{failure.outputTokens}, 0), total_token_count = total_token_count + COALESCE(#{failure.totalTokens}, 0), total_latency_millis = total_latency_millis + #{latencyMillis}, claim_token = NULL, lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, last_error_code = #{failure.errorCode}, last_error_message = #{failure.errorMessage}, finish_time = CASE WHEN #{failure.retryable} AND attempt_count < max_attempts THEN NULL ELSE #{now} END, update_time = #{now} WHERE id = #{itemId} AND claim_token = #{claimToken} AND status = 'RUNNING'

UPDATE tb_ai_log_ai_task_item SET status = 'FAILED', claim_token = NULL, lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, next_retry_time = NULL, last_error_code = #{errorCode}, last_error_message = #{errorMessage}, finish_time = #{now}, update_time = #{now} WHERE id = #{itemId} AND claim_token = #{claimToken} AND status = 'RUNNING'

UPDATE tb_ai_log_ai_task_item SET status = 'WAITING', next_retry_time = NULL, claim_token = NULL, lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, last_error_code = #{errorCode}, last_error_message = #{errorMessage}, update_time = #{now} WHERE id = #{itemId} AND claim_token = #{claimToken} AND status = 'RUNNING'
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT ai_task_id FROM tb_ai_log_ai_task_item WHERE status = 'RUNNING' AND rerun_status IS NULL AND lease_until IS NOT NULL AND lease_until < #{now}
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_ai_log_ai_task_item SET status = CASE WHEN attempt_count = 0 THEN 'WAITING' ELSE 'FAILED' END, next_retry_time = NULL, final_attempt_no = CASE WHEN attempt_count > 0 THEN attempt_count ELSE NULL END, claim_token = NULL, lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, last_error_code = 'WORKER_LOST', last_error_message = 'AI worker lease expired before completion', finish_time = CASE WHEN attempt_count > 0 THEN #{now} ELSE NULL END, update_time = #{now} WHERE status = 'RUNNING' AND rerun_status IS NULL AND lease_until IS NOT NULL AND lease_until < #{now}

UPDATE tb_ai_log_ai_task_item SET status = 'FAILED', rerun_status = 'FAILED', last_error_code = 'RERUN_CANCELLED', last_error_message = '重分析操作未能执行', finish_time = #{now}, update_time = #{now} WHERE rerun_operation_id = #{operationId} AND rerun_status = 'WAITING'
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM tb_ai_log_ai_task_item WHERE rerun_operation_id = #{operationId} AND rerun_status = 'WAITING' ORDER BY selection_order ASC, id ASC

SELECT item.id AS itemId, item.ai_task_id AS aiTaskId, item.issue_group_id AS issueGroupId, task.provider_code AS providerCode, task.model_code AS modelCode, item.attempt_count AS attemptCount, item.max_attempts AS maxAttempts FROM tb_ai_log_ai_task_item item JOIN tb_ai_log_ai_task task ON task.id = item.ai_task_id JOIN tb_ai_log_management_operation operation ON operation.id = item.rerun_operation_id WHERE item.id = #{itemId} AND item.rerun_operation_id = #{operationId} AND item.rerun_status = 'WAITING' AND item.status = 'WAITING' AND operation.status = 'RUNNING' AND operation.execution_token = #{operationExecutionToken}
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_ai_log_ai_task_item SET status = 'FAILED', rerun_status = 'FAILED', rerun_execution_token = NULL, final_attempt_no = CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tb_ai_log_ai_call_attempt attempt WHERE attempt.ai_task_item_id = tb_ai_log_ai_task_item.id AND attempt.rerun_operation_id = #{operationId} ) THEN attempt_count ELSE NULL END, claim_token = NULL, lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, next_retry_time = NULL, last_error_code = 'RERUN_WORKER_LOST', last_error_message = 'AI rerun worker lease expired before completion', finish_time = #{now}, update_time = #{now} WHERE rerun_operation_id = #{operationId} AND rerun_status = 'RUNNING' AND status = 'RUNNING' AND lease_until IS NOT NULL AND lease_until < #{now}
